turns.prompt_text: what recipes can you make with dragon fruit
turns.response_html: You can make smoothies, smoothie bowls, sorbet, juice, cakes, macarons, fruit salads, and salsas (like for fish or tacos) with dragon fruit. It's often blended, puréed, or diced.

turns.prompt_text: can you show me an easy recipe to make
turns.response_html:
The easiest recipe is a Dragon Fruit Smoothie (or "Pitaya Smoothie").

Ingredients:

  • 1 cup frozen dragon fruit (cubes or a packet)
  • 1 frozen banana (for creaminess and sweetness)
  • $1/2$ to $1$ cup liquid (milk, coconut water, or juice)

Instructions:

  1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
  2. Blend on high until completely smooth.
  3. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

Tip: Add other frozen fruits like mango or pineapple for more flavor.

turns.prompt_text: can you eat dragon fruit plain
turns.response_html: Yes, you can eat dragon fruit plain. Just slice it in half and scoop out the flesh with a spoon, or peel the skin and cut it into pieces.

turns.prompt_text: can you eat the skin of dragon fruit
turns.response_html:
The skin is generally not eaten raw due to its tough texture, but it is edible and highly nutritious after being properly washed and prepared.

You can use the skin in recipes like:

  • Stir-fries (often a Javanese-Indonesian preparation).
  • Deep-fried as a chip or garnish.
  • Dried and steeped to make tea or simple syrup.
  • Blended into smoothies.
